name: impact-shake
title: Impact Shake
description: Heavy content slams down from above with a squash, a damped camera jolt, a two-frame RGB split and dust puffs kicking out sideways. The built-in subject is a big word; a host puts its own content in by replacing the .is-word elements.
useWhen: A launch word, a price or a logo should land like it weighs a ton.
A hype edit or a social teaser needs one hard-hitting beat on the drop.
avoidWhen: The landing only needs a light accent around a small element: use trim-burst.
The element should fly in sideways with motion streaks: use speed-lines.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word that slams down. Shrinks to fit the frame width.

variables.label: Intensity
variables.description: Shake, split and dust strength, 0 to 2.

variables.label: Impact frame
variables.description: Frame (at 30 fps) when the subject hits.

variables.description: Seed for the shake phase and dust.
